 EXCLUSIVE: Just ahead of the release of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping , District 12’s Whitney Peak has closed a deal to join the new take on Serendipity from Miramax and Amazon MGM Studios , along with Off Campus breakout Stephen Kalyn .
 The duo joins the previously announced Milo Manheim. There’s no word yet on the characters they’ll play in the modern retelling.
 Michael Showalter is directing from a script by Marc Klein, who wrote the 2001 film. Showalter is also producing alongside Jordana Mollick for Semi-Formal Productions, along with Simon Fields, who produced the film. Jonathan Glickman, Alexandra Loewy and Thom Zadra are exec producing for Miramax, alongside Marc Klein.

 Emily Crook oversees for Semi-Formal, with Arianna D’Andrea overseeing for Miramax. We previously scooped both the news of this new Serendipity and the casting of Manheim. Showalter describes the project as not a straight remake or reboot, but rather a contemporary “rebuttal” of the film centered on new characters.
 Watch on Deadline 
 Directed by Peter Chelsom and starring John Cusack and Kate Beckinsale, 2001’s Serendipity centers on a couple of strangers who fall for each other one Christmas night in New York, despite being engaged to other people. Separating, their potential future together is left unresolved — until, seven years later, each begins searching for the other.
 The film released via Miramax to over $77 million worldwide. It just celebrated its 25th anniversary.
 An in-demand rising talent, Peak just signed to play Michael B. Jordan’s love interest in the upcoming Miami Vice ’85 . The new Hunger Games movie, where she stars alongside Joseph Zada and Mckenna Grace, is out this Friday. Previously best known for roles in HBO Max’s Gossip Girl reboot and Disney+’s Hocus Pocus 2 , she’ll also soon be seen in Orion Pictures’ 4 Kids Walk Into a Bank from Frankie Shaw.
 Kalyn is best known for his role of Dean Di Laurentis in Prime Video’s Off Campus , which became one of the platform’s most-watched original titles following its premiere. He steps into the leading role for the second season, releasing April 28, 2027, and off of the heat of the series, booked a role in Lionsgate’s The Housemaid’s Secret , out next December.
 Both Peak and Kalyn are repped by CAA and Play Management. Peak is also repped by Canopy Media Partners and Jackoway Austen Tyerman; Kalyn by Thruline Entertainment and Goodman, Genow, Schenkman.
